from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 10:16 2022 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 16 - 19 June 2022 Technical Delegate's Report Last night team personnel of the Alfa Romeo F1 Team ORLEN, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the eleven hour period which commenced at 23:00 on 17 June, fourteen hours before the scheduled start time of P3 and ends three hours before the scheduled start time of P3 at 10:00 on 18 June. This was the first of the two individual exceptions permitted for the Alfa Romeo F1 Team ORLEN during the 2022 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. Last night team personnel of the Haas F1 Team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the eleven hour period which commenced at 23:00 on 17 June, fourteen hours before the scheduled start time of P3 and ends three hours before the scheduled start time of P3 at 10:00 on 18 June. This was the first of the two individual exceptions permitted for the Haas F1 Team during the 2022 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
